description: This file defines the FileHandle class, which manages file chunks, reading, writing, deletion, and metadata operations within a storage system, as part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: FileHandle
classes.description: A class for handling file chunks, providing methods for reading, writing, deleting, and managing file metadata.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new FileHandle with storage, file info, and chunk list.

methods.name: readable
methods.description: Returns a ReadableStream for the file data.

methods.name: writeable
methods.description: Returns a WritableStream to write data chunks to storage.

methods.name: writeChunkAtOffset
methods.description: Writes a chunk at a specific offset.

methods.name: addAdditionalData
methods.description: Adds custom metadata to the file.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all chunks and metadata associated with the file.

methods.name: getChunkKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a chunk based on offset.

methods.name: readChunk
methods.description: Reads a specific chunk from storage.

methods.name: readChunks
methods.description: Reads multiple chunks and returns as a Blob.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Converts all chunks into a single Blob.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates total size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Lists all chunk keys for the file.

methods.name: lastOffset
methods.description: Returns the last chunk offset or -1 if none.
